name: Forcefully Yours
source:
You're relaxing for a warm afternoon, ready to enjoy a day off after a night playing games online with a friend. You're content with this however you may also have the option to do something new and exciting. 

However, whether it's with staying with the familiar, or with delving into the unknown, someone may have taken an interest in you.

An extreme interest.

[From [url=https://fuzzycuffs.itch.io/forcefully-yours]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
和朋友玩了一晚网络游戏后，你正准备享受休假，在一个温暖的午后放松身心。你对此很满足，不过也可以尝试一些新鲜刺激的事。

无论是留在熟悉的生活里，还是探索未知，都可能有人开始对你感兴趣。

而且是非常感兴趣。

[来源：[url=https://fuzzycuffs.itch.io/forcefully-yours]Itch.io[/url]]
